page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs utilizing AMD EPYC processors running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is configured with 192.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server configuration does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 13 Gbps. The instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance represents a standard general-purpose resource profile. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource contention, though the 2.25 GHz clock speed and lack of local storage represent clear tradeoffs for workloads requiring high single-core performance or low-latency local disk access. It is designed for workloads such as general-purpose web serving, enterprise applications, and distributed systems that require balanced compute and memory resources.
